g.text: Question asked (pi sees only the gateway MCP URL)
Deterministic solver ran behind the gateway
Gateway journal holds the tool call (name and arguments)
Answer equals the solver's own numbers
cmd: just demo-grid-study | pass: prints 'ground-truth (solver, no model): network=ieee39 max_line_loading_percent=... voltage_violations=...' and starts the MCP server and gateway
cmd: just demo-grid-study | pass: prints 'gateway journal (tools/call): run_power_flow {...ieee39...}'
cmd: just demo-grid-study | pass: prints 'answer vs solver: line_loading_matches=True ... violation_count_matches=True'
cmd: just demo-grid-study | pass: prints 'PASS demo-grid-study' and podman ps -a lists no wattson-gw-demo1
cmd: just demo-grid-study-nem | pass: the wattson-csiro container reports the two case files verified in out/cases, then the demo prints 'PASS demo-grid-study' for network=snem-sa-2000
